text: common way describing movement physics assigning function time xx yy. instance, Archimedean spiral known follow equations : $$ x(t) = t \cdot \cos(t) \\ y(t) = t \cdot \sin(t) $$ can encode , sample intervals 0.05 units time, using snippet : data looks like :  repeating analysis shown previous example, can significantly enrich features can see data. instance, , use color plot curvature radii size plot absolute speed.
code: # Generate the times ts <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.05)  # Calculate the positions using a function xs <- ts * cos(ts) ys <- ts * sin(ts)  # Store as data frame mov <- data.frame(t = ts,                    x = xs,                    y = ys) plot(mov$x, mov$y, xlab = "x", ylab = "y", asp = 1) mov_analyzed <- append_dynamics(mov) ggplot(data = mov_analyzed,         mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, col = curv_radius, size = aspeed)) +        geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +        coord_fixed() +        scale_color_gradient(low="blue", high="red")
